split.method: First fold of 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by registrable domain (including private suffixes). Single held-out evaluation; no tuning.

limitations: Historical dataset with source and collection bias; no temporal holdout.
Lexical signals miss compromised legitimate sites and page-content attacks.
Probabilities are uncalibrated; predicted legitimate is not guaranteed safe.
Domain-disjoint split reduces same-domain leakage, but cannot prove absence of campaign/source leakage.
